login.title: Emote Purge
login.subtitle: Log in with your Twitch account to manage the bot for your channel.

hero.badge: For Twitch streamers & their mod teams
hero.subtitle: EmotePurge shows you which emotes your chat actually uses, and removes the rest from 7TV in bulk — no guesswork. Community voting is optional, not required.

problem.title: Emote sets grow. Overview doesn't.
problem.body: After a few months, every active 7TV channel has accumulated hundreds of emotes — many long forgotten, never used, or not even wanted by the community. Figuring out by hand what's actually needed is tedious and subjective. EmotePurge turns that into a decision based on real chat data — optionally backed by real votes from your community.

features.title: Everything you need to clean up
features.subtitle: Four building blocks that together keep your emote set lean and relevant.

chatAnalytics.title: Chat analytics
chatAnalytics.description: EmotePurge tracks live which emotes your chat actually uses — per emote, over any time range you choose.

communityVoting.title: Community voting
communityVoting.description: Let viewers, subs, or mods vote thumbs up/down as well. Not required — chat analytics alone are enough to pick emotes for removal.

massDelete.title: 7TV mass delete
massDelete.description: Flag unwanted emotes and remove them from your 7TV set in one go — no clicking through the list one by one.

twitchLogin.title: Twitch login & roles
twitchLogin.description: Secure login via Twitch itself. Broadcasters, mods, and admins automatically get exactly the permissions they're entitled to.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From login to a cleaned-up set in four simple steps.

step1.title: Log in with Twitch
step1.description: One click is all it takes — no new password, no separate sign-up.

step2.title: Join a channel
step2.description: The bot joins your chat and syncs your active 7TV set automatically.

step3.title: Track usage
step3.description: Chat usage is tracked automatically — you can also start community voting, but you don't have to.

step4.title: Clean up
step4.description: Select unwanted emotes and remove them from 7TV in bulk.

finalCta.title: Ready to clean up your emote set?
finalCta.subtitle: Log in with your Twitch account and get started right away.

purge.title: Delete channel irreversibly
purge.message:
“{{channel}}” will be deleted together with its entire history: {{emotes}} emotes, all of their usage statistics, {{voteSessions}} vote sessions and every vote cast in them.

This cannot be undone. Use “Leave” instead if you only want the bot to stop counting.

sevenTvToken.intro: To delete emotes you need your own 7TV write token from your logged-in 7tv.app session:
sevenTvToken.step1: Log in on 7tv.app (if you haven't already).
sevenTvToken.step2: Open dev tools (F12) → the "Application" tab (Chrome) or "Storage" tab (Firefox) → "Local Storage" → "https://7tv.app".
sevenTvToken.step3Prefix: Find the entry with the key
sevenTvToken.securityWarning: ⚠ This token grants full write access to your 7TV account (including deleting emotes). Treat it like a password — never share it. It stays only in this browser tab (sessionStorage), is never sent to our server, and is gone once you close the tab.
